scope: TRAIN only; 22 matches; 5,372 common candidate groups; 130 completed catalog goals; input scores OOF by match

protocol.baseline: full temporal Top-60 retained in every selection
protocol.rescue_filter: skip duplicate groups and candidates within 45s of any protected or previously added candidate
protocol.goal_coverage: catalog timestamp inside any selected candidate delivery interval
protocol.cost: unique merged video-minutes and merged segments; computed against the same protected Top-60 baseline

interpretation: Exploratory post-hoc additive rescue curve on the same TRAIN/LOMO population; not independent validation and not a promotion decision. No VALIDATION or TEST accessed.
